decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presentation in both 2023 and 2024 and its strong fit with the firm’s core analytics platform suggest results at or above aspiration, so management is likely to retain it.

Although it lost its own page by 2024, it remained on the market after other nearby products disappeared, which suggests borderline but still acceptable performance and enough slack to keep it for now.

As a tool that builds on the established offer and still appears on the website in 2024, it likely supports the broader platform sufficiently to stay, despite lower prominence indicating some risk of later consolidation.
